A way back in the folder chooser, and on Unraid every share can be the download folder.

## ✨ Added

- **Every Unraid share in the folder chooser.** The Community Applications template has a new path, Unraid shares, which mounts /mnt/user at the same path inside the container. The folder chooser then lists every share, so the download folder can be any of them, for example /mnt/user/downloads. An existing container gets it when you add the path in its settings.

## 🎨 Design

- **A back arrow in the folder chooser.** The way up one folder sits in front of the path as an arrow pointing back. The small icon after the path looked like New folder.
